newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African average T-Bill rate 15.04 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.African average T-Bill rate 15.04 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for South African three-month Treasury Bills was pegged at 15.04 percent at the latest weekly tender, unchanged from last week, the Reserve Bank said.
Applications for the 700 million rand of bills on offer totalled 2.218 billion rand. The average price was 96.250 rand percent.

The average rate for six-month bills was 14.73 percent from 14.70 percent. Applications for the 200 million rand of bills on offer totalled 540 million rand. The average price was 92.655 rand percent.
